ownershipText: An international group of seasoned medical experts and hospital executives oversees Bumrungrad International Hospital, a publicly listed enterprise on the Thai Stock Exchange.

certItems: Thailand Hospital Accreditation was given to the first private hospital in 1999.
The US-based Joint Commission International (JCI) accredited Asias first hospital in 2002.
JCI renewed accreditation in 2005, 2008, 2011, 2014, 2017 and 2020
The Ministry of Labour named Thailands Model Organisation on Labour Relations Management Award recipient.
The first hospital in Thailand to get its clinical laboratory accredited by the Gold Standard of Operational Excellence, the College of American Pathologists (CAP).

The American Nurse Credentialing Centre (ANCC)s Pathway to Excellence® program, which promotes pleasant practice environments for nurses by appreciating their contributions as patient care partners, was first implemented in an Asian hospital.

socialText: The goal of the 1990-founded Bumrungrad International Hospital Foundation is to provide healthcare to impoverished Thai citizens. More than 100,000 Thais have benefited from free services offered by the Foundation, which include life-saving heart surgery for children with congenital cardiac defects and free knee replacement surgery for individuals in need of it. Bumrungrad International has been recognized by the AMCHAM for its dedication to social welfare for five years running. In 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017, Bumrungrad International received the AMCHAM "Corporate Social Responsibility Excellence Recognition - Gold Level" Award.
descriptionText: Bumrungrad International Hospital delivers world-class care with compassion and innovation, serving over 1.1 million patients annually from 190 nations.
